description: This file defines UI components related to a Drawer (sidebar/modal) using React and VAUL (a UI component library). It exports multiple React components for rendering and controlling drawer elements like Overlay, Trigger, Content, Header, Footer, Title, and Description.

methods.name: Drawer
methods.description: Main drawer component wrapping VAUL's Drawer primitive root.

methods.name: DrawerTrigger
methods.description: Component acting as a trigger to open the drawer.

methods.name: DrawerPortal
methods.description: Component for rendering the drawer portal outside the normal React DOM tree.

methods.name: DrawerOverlay
methods.description: Component rendering the overlay background with animation and styling.

methods.name: DrawerContent
methods.description: Main content area of the drawer, with direction-based styles.

methods.name: DrawerHeader
methods.description: Component for the header section inside the drawer.

methods.name: DrawerFooter
methods.description: Component for the footer section inside the drawer.

methods.name: DrawerDescription
methods.description: Component for descriptive text inside the drawer.
